boards.name: 01-daily-overview
boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high fidelity mobile UI reference board for the user's FitApp fitness accountability MVP, designed to be implementable with Tamagui Cards, YStack/XStack layout, Button, Input, Progress, ListItem, Switch and Sheet. Flat front-facing UI only, no perspective, no photoreal phone bodies, no device shadows. Landscape board, exactly 3 equal portrait mobile screens side by side, each 390:844 proportions, generous gutters, complete screens including safe areas. Board background pale warm gray, screens warm white #FAFAF7, white cards with subtle gray borders, dark ink #18231F, primary forest green #246B4B, soft lime #DDEDB5 accent, amber for pending, muted red for missed. Modern clean system sans typography, bold large numeric metrics, 24 px page gutters, 16 px card radius, 48 px minimum buttons, restrained thin line icons, large readable text. Consistent visual system, understated premium fitness journal, no photos, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no decorative charts or invented features. Screen titles and copy exact and readable. Board title small outside screens, numbered screen captions below. Four-tab screens have exactly Home, Calories, Workout, Discipline in that order with line icons and selected green state; no settings or onboarding tab. Settings accessed through header gear. Mock sample numbers not recommendations.
Board title: 'FITAPP / 01 DAILY OVERVIEW'. LEFT screen Home active: status 9:41, small 'THU, SEP 24', header 'Good morning, Rio' with gear; soft lime streak badge '7 day streak'; prominent calorie card 'Calories today', '1,650' with '/ 2,100 kcal', green linear progress at 79%, '450 kcal remaining', compact '+ Add food' action. Section 'Today’s commitments', '2 of 3 complete' and progress 67%. Three rows: 'Wake up' '6:30 AM · Completed' green check; 'Workout' '30 min · Completed' green check; 'Calorie target' 'On track · Evaluates tonight' amber clock. Small bottom note 'One commitment at a time.' Bottom nav Home active. MIDDLE screen Calories active: header 'Calories', date selector 'Today, Sep 24' chevrons, card '1,650 / 2,100 kcal', progress 79%, '450 remaining'. Meal groups with right kcal total and simple food rows: 'Breakfast' '450 kcal' 'Oats & banana'; 'Lunch' '600 kcal' 'Chicken & rice'; 'Dinner' '500 kcal' 'Salmon & vegetables'; 'Snacks' '100 kcal' 'Apple'. Large green '+ Add food' button above bottom nav. RIGHT screen Discipline active: header 'Discipline', soft lime feature card '7' 'day streak' with simple flame line icon; section 'Today’s score' '67%' '2 of 3 complete' progress; three compact commitment rows matching home; 'This week' row Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun, Mon Tue Wed completed checks, Thu amber pending, rest gray; legend 'Complete / Pending'; outlined 'View history' row. Bottom nav Discipline active. Captions '01 Home', '02 Calories', '03 Discipline'.
